voice.welcome: Welcome to Happy Ripe Fruit! Tap the basket and let's pick together.
voice.choose-patch: Our fruit garden is ready. Choose the glowing fruit patch.
voice.strawberry-prompt: Find the strawberry that is deep red and juicy. Put the ripe one in the basket!
voice.banana-prompt: Find the banana that is golden yellow and gently curved. Put the ripe one in the basket!
voice.apple-prompt: Find the apple that is shiny bright red and plump. Put the ripe one in the basket!
voice.lemon-prompt: Find the lemon that is sunny yellow and smooth. Put the ripe one in the basket!
voice.cherry-prompt: Find the cherries that are deep ruby red and glossy. Put the ripe pair in the basket!
voice.pear-prompt: Find the pear that is golden green, smooth, and plump. Put the ripe one in the basket!
voice.retry-early: That fruit needs a little more sunshine. Try the ripe one.
voice.retry-late: That fruit waited a little too long. Try the ripe one.
voice.praise-one: Pop! That fruit is just right.
voice.praise-three: You spotted the happy ripe fruit!
voice.strawberry-complete: Three ruby strawberries! Your berry badge is blooming.
voice.banana-complete: Three golden bananas! Your banana badge is shining.
voice.apple-complete: Three bright apples! Your apple badge is sparkling.
voice.lemon-complete: Three sunny lemons! Your lemon badge is glowing.
voice.cherry-complete: Three ruby cherry pairs! Your cherry badge is twinkling.
voice.pear-complete: Three golden pears! Your pear badge is gleaming.
voice.finale: Your whole rainbow harvest is ripe and ready. What a careful fruit picker!
voice.idle: Look closely at the colors and the skin. Which fruit is just right?
